captured_note: Ported from the capture's self-contained methods/31_dinov3, specifically its step 2 (train_step2_vit.py, models/*, losses/*, data/multicrop.py, evaluate_linear.py, configs/step2_vit.yaml). This is the lab's own implementation of Simeoni et al. (2025) DINOv3. The capture's step 1 (run_step1_eval.py, configs/step1_original.yaml) loads the official DINOv3 weights from HuggingFace because the from-scratch data (LVD-1689M) is not public; those weights are HF login-gated, and that download is the capture's excluded step. What is ported here is the capture's step 2: the from-scratch 'unified SSL comparison' that trains a DINOv3 representation on ImageNet-1k, which is self-contained torch-only code (the ViT, the DINO/iBOT/KoLeo/Gram losses and the multi-crop dataset are all the lab's own; measured: no timm/transformers/hf import in the step-2 path). The port keeps the capture directory numbering (31) per the 2026-08-09 keep-capture-numbering decision (this list's number 35 is DINOv3 -- see docs/PORTING_ROADMAP.md).

paper.title: DINOv3
paper.authors: Simeoni, Vo, Seitzer, Baldassarre, Oquab, Jose, Khalidov, Szafraniec, Yi, Ramamonjisoa, et al.

licence_note: This port is a self-contained re-implementation of the DINOv3 method (the lab's own code, referencing the paper); it trains from scratch on ImageNet and uses NO Meta-released DINOv3 code or weights. The official facebookresearch/dinov3 code and the pretrained weights carry Meta's custom, gated 'DINOv3 License'; none of it is copied, downloaded, or required here -- the capture's step 1 that would fetch the gated weights is the excluded step. So no third-party licence attaches to this port's files, which carry this repository's licence.
scope: The from-scratch step 2 (the unified SSL comparison) is ported as this port's step 1, DINOv3's CORE objective: a student ViT-B/16 (4 register tokens + axial RoPE) and an EMA teacher see multi-crop views (2 global 224 + 8 local 96); the loss is L_DINO (a cross-view distillation with Sinkhorn-Knopp / SwAV centering of the teacher assignments) + L_iBOT (a masked-patch distillation, block masks on the global crops) + koleo_weight * L_KoLeo (a Kozachenko-Leonenko spread on the CLS batch). AdamW under a cosine LR schedule with warmup; teacher-temperature warmup; EMA momentum cosine. The released Gram anchoring second stage (epochs 251-300, a snapshotted Gram teacher) is EXCLUDED -- the capture exposes it as gram.mode with core_only as a first-class mode, and this port runs core_only, the same way every port excludes a secondary stage. The capture's step 1 (loading the HF-gated official weights) is also excluded.
encoder: encoder.pt is the EMA teacher's ViT backbone (backbone.* from teacher_state_dict, the prefix stripped so it loads into a plain VisionTransformer): the patch embed, cls/register tokens, RoPE blocks and the final norm, producing the CLS feature (embed_dim; 768 for ViT-B/16). The DINO and iBOT projection heads and the student are training machinery and are excluded; the teacher is the representation DINO-family methods are known for.
linear_eval: Reads the trained encoder.pt and probes the teacher backbone's CLS token (backbone(x, is_global=True)[0], the released output norm included), a genuine learned representation, so the number is comparable. Images use the deterministic val pipeline (resize + centre crop, ImageNet normalisation). The capture's own DINOv3 eval trains plain linear heads on the frozen backbone; this port follows the lab's shared ARSSL probe (mean-centre + L2-normalise features, single linear layer, SGD momentum + cosine, top1/top5) instead, so the number is comparable across the ported methods.
rewritten_during_the_port: the capture's step 1 (loading the HF-gated official DINOv3 weights on the unavailable LVD-1689M) is excluded; the from-scratch step 2 (unified SSL comparison on ImageNet) is what is ported

the Gram anchoring second stage is excluded (the capture's gram.mode: core_only); the DINO + iBOT + KoLeo core objective is ported. The GramLoss module is shipped verbatim for completeness but is not wired into the loss

the ViT (register tokens + axial RoPE), the DINO/iBOT/KoLeo losses (Sinkhorn-Knopp centering) and the multi-crop dataset are the lab's own torch-only code, ported faithfully; the DDP paths (all_reduce in the losses, DistributedSampler in the loader) are made inert / single-process
the device is resolved (resolve_device) instead of assumed CUDA (the capture called .cuda())
main() split into build_parser()/run(args, config) returning the pretext loss and epoch count
the run is seeded through make_deterministic (python, numpy, torch); the DataLoader gets a seeded generator

the training loop drops the upstream DistributedDataParallel and TensorBoard/tqdm, single-process fp32; a plain cosine LR + teacher-temp warmup + teacher-EMA cosine schedule replaces the capture's Gram two-stage optimizer-step clock (core-only)
encoder.pt is the EMA teacher backbone (backbone.* stripped); the probe follows the lab's shared ARSSL protocol so the number is comparable across the ported methods
DATA_ROOT is the dataset root; the pretrain stage reads its train/ subdirectory (unified data-root convention via adapterlib.dataset_split_dir).
